设计意图： This preserves the qualified parent's crash-fragility mechanism: stocks whose realized variance is persistently dominated by losses may remain vulnerable to adverse repricing. The sole mutation lengthens the causal EWMA span from 30 to 45 sessions, filtering transient one-day loss shocks and reducing signal churn. The target is the parent's failed top-quantile payoff and negative annualized excess

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(ts_ema(power(clip(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), , ), 2), 45), ts_ema(power(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 2), 45))
  2. 2. ts_ema —— 指数移动平均
    ts_ema(power(clip(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), , ), 2), 45)
  3. 3. power —— 取幂(乘方)
    power(clip(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), , ), 2)
  4. 4. clip —— 裁剪到区间[下限,上限]
    clip(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), , )
  5. 5. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)
  6. 6. ts_ema —— 指数移动平均
    ts_ema(power(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 2), 45)
  7. 7. power —— 取幂(乘方)
    power(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 2)
  8. 8. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
power计算 x 的 y 次方
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  2. 计算 downside_variance：ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2).ewm(span=45, min_periods=30, adjust=False).mean()
  3. 计算 total_variance：ret.pow(2).ewm(span=45, min_periods=30, adjust=False).mean()

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_persistent_left_tail_variance_share(df): """Persistent exponentially weighted share of realized variance ">class="kw">from negative returns.""" df_copy = df.copy() ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change() downside_variance = ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2).ewm(span=45, min_periods=30, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() total_variance = ret.pow(2).ewm(span=45, min_periods=30, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() df_copy["factor_persistent_left_tail_variance_share"] = downside_variance / total_variance.replace(0.0, np.nan) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_persistent_left_tail_variance_share"]
